guitar.modelsText: Kramer (Sambora signature, e.g. Wedge/Tour custom) / Ovation acoustic
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Sambora was a long-time Kramer endorser with his own custom guitars; Ovation was commonly used for acoustic ballads.
guitar.notes: Refined to lead with Kramer since that's Sambora's most documented brand association.

tone.target: bright 80s arena crunch with chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright 80s arena crunch with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A classic British crunchy tone (UK 45/50) with a touch of compression, Chorus modulation, and Digital Delay to achieve the polished, anthemic sound of 80s stadium rock.

rig.name: Bon Jovi - Livin' On A Prayer - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain signal clarity.
Provide a tight, mid-focused crunch boost suitable for rhythm playing without excessive grit.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate the punchy, slightly scooped mids of classic British rock amps (like JCM), keeping the tone crunchy rather than heavily distorted.

blocks.purpose: Add the signature 'sheen' and width required for chorused lead lines in 80s arena rock.
Provide the necessary mid-gain crunch and grit for rhythm parts without sounding like modern metal distortion.
blocks.gap: While 'RAT-style' is a general overdrive, it provides the aggressive, focused midrange bite needed to cut through a stadium mix better than pure OD pedals.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, punchy British rock tone (JCM-esque) required for the era.
Provide the classic British rock cabinet sound and necessary high-end sparkle.
Slightly boost the upper mids and treble to achieve 'bright upper mids' and polish the overall tone.
Add the signature 'stadium polish' and rhythmic echo effect common in 80s anthemic rock.
Provide a subtle sense of space and polish without muddying the tight crunch.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better upper-mid definition and vintage punch.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, mid-focused crunch required for 80s arena rock polish.
